# Load the sales data

missing_age = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check data type of customer_age
dtype_age = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check for any non-numeric values or outliers
unique_ages = sales_df['customer_age'].unique()

missing_age, dtype_age, unique_ages"}
